description: Door-task pose plan for the door_push_alex_v2 v2_pose dataset: 5 deterministic poses (yaw about the hinge axis plus world XY offset), probe-gated for Alex V2 reachability before generation. Per pose, one fixed-seed probe episode ran through the full calibrated stack (validated calibration 066e0a2d0157549a331b96702e643fd7626eed58d33bbe701005e111ed358948, IK40 right-arm PD, collision-offset tool point, filtered door-panel force) and had to succeed with zero sanity errors and full force admission. Pose k owns seed block [10k, 10k+9]: 2 fixed plus 8 randomized episodes.
overdraw_policy: Scripted randomization has a small task-failure rate (controller phase timeouts). Failed draws are never silently included or hidden: they are skipped, reported in the manifest (skipped_episodes), and replaced in deterministic seed order from the pose's disjoint overdraw namespace (overdraw_base_seed + i, randomized draws), generated as a pose<id>_overdraw run. Overdraw seeds (500+) never collide with pose blocks (0-49) or the held-out evaluation seeds (100-119).

force_admission_policy.note: Every recorded control-tick force sample must be finite and within [0, 200] N; enforced as a hard sanity error at generation time and re-checked before merged export.

probe.source: verify_alex_v2_door_baseline.py fixed + 5 randomized episodes (all success) and alex_v2_smoke 2-fixed-episode run (2/2 success, 60.7 deg mean)
